description: Fly.io deployment config for Yamtrack self-hosted media tracker
readmeMarkdown:
# Yamtrack on Fly.io

Fly.io deployment config for [Yamtrack](https://github.com/FuzzyGrim/Yamtrack), a self-hosted media tracker. Auto-suspends when idle, cold-starts on next request (~5–10s).

## Prerequisites

- [`fly` CLI](https://fly.io/docs/flyctl/install/) installed and authenticated
- A [Fly.io](https://fly.io) account

## Setup

```bash
# 1. Create the app (check the assigned name — used in URLS below)
fly apps create yamtrack

# 2. Create Redis (Upstash free tier — say No to eviction)
fly redis create
# Name it e.g. "yamtrack-redis", region: lax

# 3. Set secrets (use Redis URL printed after step 2)
fly secrets set REDIS_URL="redis://..." URLS="https://<your-app-name>.fly.dev"

# 4. Create persistent volume for SQLite
fly volumes create yamtrack_db --region lax --size 1

# 5. Deploy
fly deploy
```

## Migrating existing data

```bash
fly sftp shell
# then: put db/db.sqlite3 /yamtrack/db/db.sqlite3
```

## Ongoing

```bash
fly logs       # tail logs
fly status     # machine status
fly ssh console  # shell into running machine
fly deploy     # redeploy after fly.toml changes
```

## Notes

- First request after a cold start may briefly 502 (~5s) while gunicorn starts — a refresh always works
- Cost: ~$0/mo on free tier (3 shared VMs included) + ~$0.15/mo for the 1 GB volume
